actions.check_invitation_status.descript: Check the status of a connection invitation sent to a profile.
actions.check_invitation_status.props.ac: The connected LinkedIn account to act as. Get it from the "List Accounts" action.
actions.custom_api_call.description: Make a custom API call to a specific endpoint
actions.custom_api_call.props.failsafe.d: On a failed request, output the error instead of failing the step.
actions.custom_api_call.props.followRedi: Follow 3xx redirects instead of returning them as the response.
actions.custom_api_call.props.headers.de: Authorization headers are injected automatically from your connection.
actions.custom_api_call.props.response_i: Enable for files like PDFs, images, etc.
actions.custom_api_call.props.timeout.de: Seconds to wait for a response. Empty: up to the flow limit (10 min).
actions.get_account.description: Get detailed information and status for a specific connected account. Free (0 credits).
actions.get_company.description: Retrieve detailed information about a LinkedIn company page.
actions.get_company.props.accountId.desc: The connected LinkedIn account to act as. Get it from the "List Accounts" action.
actions.get_conversation.description: Retrieve the message history of a LinkedIn conversation, by conversation ID or profile URL.
actions.get_conversation.props.accountId: The connected LinkedIn account to act as. Get it from the "List Accounts" action.
actions.get_conversation.props.conversat: Provide this OR a Profile URL
actions.get_conversation.props.cursor.de: Pagination cursor from a previous response
actions.get_conversation.props.profileUr: Profile URL of the other participant
actions.get_my_profile.description: Retrieve the profile of the connected LinkedIn account.
actions.get_my_profile.props.accountId.d: The connected LinkedIn account to act as. Get it from the "List Accounts" action.
actions.get_profile.description: Retrieve detailed information about a LinkedIn profile by URL, public identifier, or URN.
actions.get_profile.props.accountId.desc: The connected LinkedIn account to act as. Get it from the "List Accounts" action.
actions.get_profile.props.profileUrl.des: Full LinkedIn profile URL (provide this OR Identifier OR URN)
actions.list_accounts.description: List all connected LinkedIn accounts linked to your API key. Free (0 credits). Use the returned account_id in other actions.
actions.list_accounts.props.limit.descri: Max accounts to return per page (1-500)
actions.list_accounts.props.offset.descr: Number of accounts to skip (for pagination)
actions.search_companies.description: Search LinkedIn companies by keyword, location, sector and company size.
actions.search_companies.props.accountId: The connected LinkedIn account to act as. Get it from the "List Accounts" action.
actions.search_people.description: Search LinkedIn profiles by keyword, company, title, location, school, industry and more. Returns the LinkedIn URL of each match.
actions.search_people.props.accountId.de: The connected LinkedIn account to act as. Get it from the "List Accounts" action.
actions.search_people.props.connectionOf: Show connections of a specific profile (URL or identifier)
actions.search_people.props.fetchInvitat: Include the connection invitation state for each result
actions.search_people.props.followerOf.d: Show followers of a specific company or profile
actions.search_people.props.network.desc: Connection degree relative to the account
actions.search_people.props.totalResults: Number of results to return (1 credit per 10 results)
actions.send_connection_request.descript: Send a LinkedIn connection invitation to a profile, with an optional note.
actions.send_connection_request.props.ac: The connected LinkedIn account to act as. Get it from the "List Accounts" action.
actions.send_connection_request.props.me: Optional note to include with the invitation
actions.send_connection_request.props.pr: LinkedIn profile URL (provide this OR Identifier)
actions.send_message.description: Send a LinkedIn message to a profile, optionally with a media attachment.
actions.send_message.props.accountId.des: The connected LinkedIn account to act as. Get it from the "List Accounts" action.
actions.send_message.props.mediaLink.des: Optional URL of a media file to attach
actions.send_message.props.messageText.d: The text of the message to send
actions.send_message.props.profileUrl.de: LinkedIn profile URL of the recipient
auth.description: Your LinkupAPI key, sent as the `x-api-key` header. Get it from https://app.linkupapi.com
description: LinkupAPI lets agents send messages, manage conversations, and automate outreach across every channel, for sales and recruitment.
triggers.invitation_accepted.description: Fires in real time when a connection request sent from the connected LinkedIn account is accepted. Registers a LinkupAPI webhook (≈10 credits/day per monitored account while active).
triggers.invitation_accepted.props.accou: The connected LinkedIn account to act as. Get it from the "List Accounts" action.
triggers.new_message_received.descriptio: Fires in real time when the connected LinkedIn account receives a new message. Registers a LinkupAPI webhook (≈10 credits/day per monitored account while active).
triggers.new_message_received.props.acco: The connected LinkedIn account to act as. Get it from the "List Accounts" action.
